name: The Hershey Company
summary: The Hershey Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of confectionery products and pantry items in the United States and internationally. It operates through three segments: North America Confectionery, North America Salty Snacks, and International. verdict: Einstufung: Qualität (Buffett-Typ) – erfüllt 7/9 Buffett-Kriterien – stabiler, profitabler Burggraben. Buffett-Score 66/100 (Top-Firma, aber zu teuer), Innovations-Score 16/100 (Noch zu früh/zu teuer). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 115.90 USD (−34 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Niedrig.
